decided: LST-7 (#7489), per epic #7481's bounded set (alert channels and policies)
decision: Alert policies are configuration, not a ledger: an org writes a handful and edits them in place. The Policies list stays one filtered read (`alerts.policies` → `queryAlertPoliciesPage`), rendered whole, with facets over the org's unfiltered policies and no count pill.
bound: `ALERT_POLICIES_MAX` (100) in apps/console/lib/queries/alerts-lists.ts, enforced at create by `createPolicy` (app/server/actions/alerts.ts) under a per-org transaction lock; the read never cuts at it.
